senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. רָתַךְ)to join; (denom. מרתק, v. מַרְתּוֹקָא; knuckles, fist, whence:) רָתַק (cmp. סָטַר) to strike with the knuckles.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Zavim 4:1">Tosef. Zab. IV, 1</cite> <he>רוֹתְקוֹ</he> ed. Zuck. (ed. <he>התקו</he>, corr. acc.) if he knuckles him, contrad. to <cite ref="V00905"><he>תָּקַע</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to knock. Y. Ber. I, 2ᵈ bot. בא וה׳ על פתחו וכ׳ (not והרחיק) came and knocked at the king’s door.
units: Ex. R. s. 33 (ref. to Cant. V, 2) אני ישנה … והקב״ה מַרְתִּיק עליו (not עלי) ‘I (Israel) was asleep’ after making the golden calf, but ‘my heart awoke’, when the Lord knocked at it, … ‘open unto me &c.’ Ex. R. s. 27 כשנגלה … שלא ה׳ עליה when the Lord revealed himself at Mount Sinai, there was not a nation at whose doors he did not knock, but they declined &c. Pesik. Aḥăré, p. 176ᵃ שאם יַרְתִּיק וכ׳ Ar. (ed. יְרַתֵּק Pi.) if he knocks, they will open for him (if he studies, he will enter into the interior of learning), if for Talmud &c.; Lev. R. s. 21 ירתק; a. e.—2) (with אחר) to shake the fist at, to rebel.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45:5">Gen. R. s. 45</cite> <he>כל מי שה׳ אחר מדת הדין וכ׳</he> whosoever rebelled against divine justice, did not come out unscathed from under its hands.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite> (expl. <cite ref="M03007"><he>מתאימות</he></cite>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4">ib.</cite>) <he>אלו שתי … כמין שתים נִרְתָּקוֹת</he> (not <cite ref="N01278"><he>נרתיקות</he></cite>) this refers to the two cord-like chains of gold which came forth from the breast-plate, and which appeared like two welded together.
